description: Single-axis motor controller with homing support. Drives a motor to a target position using encoder pulse counting or time-based step control.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: Target position in encoder counts. Movement starts automatically after homing.

inputs.name: Encoder
inputs.description: Raw encoder pulse input. Each rising edge counts one step in the current motor direction.

inputs.name: Home
inputs.description: Pulse input. Rising edge starts the homing sequence, moving the motor in the configured direction until the home switch activates.

inputs.name: Home switch
inputs.description: Active (true) when the axis is at the home/reference position. Used during homing to detect arrival at the reference point.

inputs.name: Stop
inputs.description: Pulse input. Rising edge stops all movement and cancels homing. Dominant input. Position and homed status are preserved.

inputs.name: Home before move
inputs.description: When active, the motor automatically homes before moving to each new target. If the home switch is already active, movement starts immediately from position zero. Otherwise, the motor homes first and then proceeds to the target.

outputs.name: Forward
outputs.description: Active when the motor should drive in the positive direction.

outputs.name: Reverse
outputs.description: Active when the motor should drive in the negative direction.

outputs.name: At target
outputs.description: True when the current position is within the configured tolerance of the target.

outputs.name: Homed
outputs.description: True after a successful homing sequence has completed.

outputs.name: Moving
outputs.description: True when the motor is actively driving in either direction.

config.name: Home direction
config.description: Motor direction during the homing sequence.

config.name: Position tolerance
config.description: Maximum acceptable distance from the target position to be considered at target. 0 means exact match.

config.name: Control mode
config.description: Encoder mode uses external encoder pulses to track position. Time-based mode uses internally timed steps, where each position unit corresponds to a configured time duration.

config.name: Pulse time forward
config.description: Duration of one position step when moving in the forward direction. Only used in time-based control mode.

config.name: Pulse time reverse
config.description: Duration of one position step when moving in the reverse direction. Only used in time-based control mode.

state.name: Previous encoder state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the encoder input to detect rising edges.

state.name: Previous home state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the home input to detect rising edges.

state.name: Previous stop state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the stop input to detect rising edges.

state.name: Is homing
state.description: True while the homing sequence is in progress.

state.name: Pending target
state.description: Stores the target position to move to after homing completes when home-before-move is active.

state.name: Move after home
state.description: True when the motor should automatically move to the pending target after homing completes.

state.name: Steps left
state.description: Remaining virtual pulse steps in the current time-based movement.
